transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm here today because I've been struggling with feeling constantly restless and finding it really hard to sit still without fidgeting. I've also been making a lot of careless mistakes lately because I just can't seem to focus on the details of my work. It's getting really frustrating to deal with, so I wanted to get some help.
Have these struggles with focus, restlessness, and fidgeting been going on since your childhood, or did they start more recently as an adult?

They've actually been going on since I was a kid, definitely starting before I turned 12. I remember always getting in trouble for fidgeting and not paying attention back then too. It's just that they've become a constant, daily struggle for about the last year and eight months.
Along with these struggles, do you experience constant, excessive worry about everyday things that you find very difficult to control?
No, I wouldn't say I experience constant or uncontrollable worry about everyday things. It's more about the physical restlessness and trouble focusing rather than feeling anxious.
Do you also frequently find yourself acting on impulse, such as interrupting others, blurting out thoughts, or having a hard time waiting your turn?
I don't really have those specific issues, to be honest. I don't find myself interrupting people or struggling to wait my turn.
Do you also frequently find yourself easily distracted by things around you, struggling to organize tasks, or forgetting daily appointments and losing items?
No, I don't really struggle with being easily distracted or organizing my tasks. I also don't have much of an issue with forgetting appointments or losing my things.
Do you often feel 'on the go' as if driven by a motor, or find yourself talking excessively even when it's not appropriate?
No, I wouldn't say I feel like I'm driven by a motor. I also don't think I have an issue with talking excessively either.
Do you often find it difficult to follow through on instructions and fail to finish work tasks, or do you frequently avoid projects that require a lot of mental effort?
No, I don't really struggle with following through on instructions or finishing my tasks. I also don't find myself avoiding projects that require a lot of mental effort.
Have you also been experiencing a persistently low, sad, or empty mood, or a loss of interest or pleasure in things you normally enjoy during this time?
No, I haven't really been experiencing a low mood or a loss of interest in things. For the most part, my mood has been okay aside from the frustration with my restlessness.
Have you ever had periods lasting several days where you felt unusually happy, irritable, or energetic, and needed much less sleep than usual?

No, I've never experienced periods like that where I felt unusually happy or energetic for days. My sleep has also been pretty normal, so I haven't had times where I needed much less sleep than usual.
